method: Controlled own-team gem profiles versus fixed balanced opponents; independently randomized per-hero recipes with equal role schedules; fresh gem/trio selection; all ten selected role builds in an independent reversed-side round robin. Same-role opponents excluded from aggregate role ranking. Fixed tank/support/damage alphabetical formation. Current AI on both sides. Stratified 2,000-sample bootstrap of complete reversed pairs.
limits: Role groups are equally weighted, not weighted by the number of available hero trios. All 1,140 hero combinations appear in mixed play, but all 1,000 gem allocations per trio are not exhaustively tested. Gem effects in the controlled stage apply to uniform recipes on all three heroes versus fixed balanced opponents; they are not a global optimum for every hero. Selected builds are sample winners among tested candidates. Bootstrap is conditional on sampled lineups and finalists. AI behavior can differ from human PvP. Simulation writes no production player logs.
